title: ‘Never Surrender’ Trailer Sees a Grandpa Risking Everything for His Family
summary: Directed by Sidharta Tata, the action film tells the story of an unlikely hero who fights to reunite his family.
body_markdown:

Netflix has unveiled the trailer and main key art for its latest Indonesian film,


Never Surrender


, premiering on


November 12.


Directed by


Sidharta Tata


, the action film tells the story of an unlikely hero who fights to reunite his family.


The trailer offers a glimpse into the chain of events that unfold when the unexpected arrival of his two grandchildren thrusts a grandfather into a dangerous situation. Accustomed to living alone, the grandfather — drawing upon his past experience as a special forces operative — deploys his combat skills to protect his family from a criminal syndicate. With the threat closing in, the grandfather and his grandchildren are left with only two choices to survive: surrender or fight back.


Set in a small village in Central Java,


Never Surrender


is more than just an action film. It balances high-stakes combat with a heartfelt story about family, highlighting the emotional journey of three generations as they rebuild trust amid grief and atone for the past. Combining intense fight sequences, tactical ingenuity and family dynamics that feel grounded in real life,


Never Surrender


marks Sidharta Tata’s first collaboration with renowned producers


Kimo Stamboel


and


Edwin Nazir


.


Starring


Lukman Sardi


,


Callista Arum


,


Sulthan Hamonangan


,


Derby Romero


and


Donny Alamsyah


,


Never Surrender


premieres November 12, only on Netflix.
